requirements_source_semantics.semantics: 74 unique training session EIDs,10 unique heldout EIDs,zero overlap; paper describes73 training animals+10 heldout,one training animal two insertions. EID does not establish animal identity; authenticated join remains required.

Per-neuron Poisson log-likelihood gain versus neuron-specific constant mean over evaluated counts, divided by neuron spike count and ln2; session neuron-macro mean. Zero-rate code policy1e-9; source infinity-to-NaN handling must remain distinct from any strict prospective rejection.

Choice/block ordinary classification accuracy; balanced accuracy is secondary author code output. Continuous single-trial R2 flattens trials/time and is un-clipped on actual viz_single_cell→plot_psth→compute_R2_main(clip=False) evaluation path, despite helper default clipping.

Mask1means hidden token replaced with learned token after embedding. Encoding hides every spike token; decoding hides all four behavior modalities. Individual-variable encoding exposes only selected behavior. Arbitrary loader target/reward/contrast aliases must not become predictor inputs.
ap→spike; wheel-speed→wheel; whisker-motion-energy→whisker; raw choice-1→0,+1→1; raw block.2→0,.5→1,.8→2. Reject unknown/no-choice or ambiguous encoded/raw conventions.
